notes.title: Update: Major Fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
Major Fixes 

Checkpoints now correctly save progress after completing a quest.,

Fixed a bug where the camera effect was missing when using items or encountering jump scares.,

Route markers no longer disappear after saving and reloading the game.,

Anomalies no longer instantly kill the player: they now deal only mental damage as intended. Damage balance has been adjusted for correct behavior.,

Fixed a bug where a jumpscare inside the car could appear multiple times in a row.,

Interface & Controls 

Added colors to tutorial key prompts for better readability.,

Adjusted tutorial text descriptions.,

Manual gear shifting with Shift and Control has been removed.,

In fullscreen mode, the mouse is now correctly locked to the screen and no longer “jumps” between monitors.,

Added hotkeys to the car interface.,

 Menu & Settings 

Fixed a bug with the menu slider.
